title: Clean: timeout retry added around a payment capture keyed for idempotency
diff: """Payment capture, called when an order ships."""
-    """Capture the authorized amount for a shipped order."""
+    """Capture the authorized amount for a shipped order.
+    Retried on timeout. Safe for a payment call because the gateway
+    deduplicates on idempotency_key: our key is derived from the
+    order id alone, so every attempt for this order -- in this
+    process or any other -- sends the identical key, and the gateway
+    contract guarantees at most one capture per key (retries of a
+    completed capture return the original result).
+- Payment capture now retries gateway timeouts (3 attempts, linear
+  backoff). Captures are idempotency-keyed by order id, so retries
+  cannot double-capture; see the capture_payment docstring.

ground_truth.explanation: Retrying a payment call on timeout is the classic double-charge setup, and a reviewer pattern-matching on 'retry + capture' will want to flag it. Here it is the correct implementation of the standard safe pattern: the idempotency key is derived from the order id alone, so every attempt -- including one from a different process after a crash -- carries the identical key, and the gateway contract (stated in the docstring, and standard for payment processors) guarantees at most one capture per key, with retries of a completed capture returning the original result. A per-attempt or timestamped key WOULD be the double-charge bug; the tests pin exactly the property that prevents it (all retry attempts share one key).
